mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, agent_external_id, name, channel_type, mode, identity_resolution_mode, identity_uuid, entry_closed, enabled, binding_status, app_id, app_secret_envelope::text AS app_secret_envelope, include_thinking, include_tool_calls, reply_in_thread, mounts::text AS mounts, git_token_envelope::text AS git_token_envelope, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO channels ( external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, agent_external_id, name, channel_type, mode, enabled, binding_status, app_id, app_secret_envelope, include_thinking, include_tool_calls, reply_in_thread, mounts, git_token_envelope, identity_resolution_mode, identity_uuid ) VALUES ( #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.AgentExternalID}, #{params.Name}, #{params.ChannelType}, #{params.Mode}, #{params.Enabled}, #{params.BindingStatus}, #{params.AppID}, CAST(#{params.AppSecretEnvelope} AS jsonb), #{params.IncludeThinking}, #{params.IncludeToolCalls}, #{params.ReplyInThread}, CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(#{params.Mounts}, ''), '{}') AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.GitTokenEnvelope} AS jsonb), #{params.ExecutionMode}, #{params.IdentityUUID} ) RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM channels WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND enabled = true AND binding_status = 'bound' ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.update:
UPDATE channels SET name = #{params.Name},
identity_resolution_mode = #{params.ExecutionMode}, identity_uuid = #{params.IdentityUUID},
execution_revision = execution_revision + CASE WHEN
(identity_resolution_mode IS NOT NULL AND identity_uuid IS DISTINCT FROM CAST(#{params.IdentityUUID} AS uuid)) OR
(identity_resolution_mode = 'fixed' AND (mounts ->> 'agent_version') IS DISTINCT FROM (CAST(NULLIF(#{params.Mounts}, '') AS jsonb) ->> 'agent_version')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, enabled = #{params.Enabled}, binding_status = #{params.BindingStatus}, app_id = #{params.AppID}, app_secret_envelope = CAST(#{params.AppSecretEnvelope} AS jsonb), include_thinking = #{params.IncludeThinking}, include_tool_calls = #{params.IncludeToolCalls}, reply_in_thread = #{params.ReplyInThread}, mounts = COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(#{params.Mounts}, '') AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb), git_token_envelope = CAST(#{params.GitTokenEnvelope} AS jsonb), updated_at = now() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
AND (identity_resolution_mode IS NULL OR identity_resolution_mode = #{params.ExecutionMode}) AND (entry_closed = false OR identity_uuid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(#{params.IdentityUUID} AS uuid))
RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT external_id, channel_external_id, kind, target, display_name, status, created_at FROM channel_access_pairings WHERE channel_external_id = #{channelExternalID} ORDER BY created_at, id
SELECT count(*) FROM channel_access_pairings WHERE channel_external_id = #{channelExternalID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO channel_access_pairings (external_id, channel_external_id, kind, target, display_name) VALUES (#{params.ExternalID}, #{params.ChannelExternalID}, #{params.Kind}, #{params.Target}, #{params.DisplayName}) ON CONFLICT (channel_external_id, kind, target) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO channel_agent_settings (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, agent_external_id, environment_external_id) VALUES (#{organizationUUID}, #{workspaceUUID}, #{agentExternalID}, #{environmentExternalID}) ON CONFLICT (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, agent_external_id) DO UPDATE SET environment_external_id = EXCLUDED.environment_external_id, updated_at = now()
mapper.sql: d.uuid, d.external_id, d.channel_uuid, d.channel_external_id, d.channel_type, d.account_id, d.input_event_id, d.session_external_id, d.scope_key, d.message_id, d.chat_id, d.chat_type, d.actor_id, d.root_id, d.thread_id, d.reply_message_id, d.include_thinking, d.include_tool_calls, d.state, d.lease_owner, d.lease_until, CAST(d.artifact_delivery AS text) AS artifact_delivery
mapper.select: WITH changed AS ( INSERT INTO channel_reply_deliveries AS d (uuid, external_id, channel_uuid, channel_external_id, channel_type, account_id, input_event_id, session_external_id, scope_key, message_id, chat_id, chat_type, actor_id, root_id, thread_id, include_thinking, include_tool_calls, artifact_delivery) SELECT #{input.UUID}, #{input.ExternalID}, c.uuid, c.external_id, #{input.ChannelType}, #{input.AccountID}, #{input.InputEventID}, #{input.SessionExternalID}, #{input.ScopeKey}, #{input.MessageID}, #{input.ChatID}, #{input.ChatType}, #{input.ActorID}, #{input.RootID}, #{input.ThreadID}, #{input.IncludeThinking}, #{input.IncludeToolCalls}, COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(#{input.ArtifactDelivery,sensitive=true}, '') AS jsonb), CAST('{}' AS jsonb)) FROM channels c WHERE c.external_id = #{scope.ChannelExternalID} AND c.organization_uuid = #{scope.OrganizationUUID} AND c.workspace_uuid = #{scope.WorkspaceUUID} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ON CONFLICT (channel_uuid, input_event_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING uuid, external_id, channel_uuid, channel_external_id, channel_type, account_id, input_event_id, session_external_id, scope_key, message_id, chat_id, chat_type, actor_id, root_id, thread_id, reply_message_id, include_thinking, include_tool_calls, state, lease_owner, lease_until, artifact_delivery ) SELECT FROM changed d
SELECT FROM channel_reply_deliveries d WHERE AND d.input_event_id = #{inputID}

WITH changed AS ( UPDATE channel_reply_deliveries d SET lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = now() + interval '30 seconds', state = CASE WHEN state = 'pending' THEN 'sending' ELSE state END, updated_at = now() WHERE AND d.input_event_id = #{inputID} AND (d.state = 'pending' OR d.state = 'sent' AND d.lease_until < now()) RETURNING uuid, external_id, channel_uuid, channel_external_id, channel_type, account_id, input_event_id, session_external_id, scope_key, message_id, chat_id, chat_type, actor_id, root_id, thread_id, reply_message_id, include_thinking, include_tool_calls, state, lease_owner, lease_until, artifact_delivery ) SELECT FROM changed d

WITH changed AS ( UPDATE channel_reply_deliveries d SET reply_message_id = #{receipt}, state = 'sent', lease_until = now() + interval '30 seconds', updated_at = now() WHERE AND d.input_event_id = #{inputID} AND d.lease_owner = #{owner} AND d.state IN ('sending', 'unconfirmed') RETURNING input_event_id ) SELECT input_event_id FROM changed

WITH changed AS ( UPDATE channel_reply_deliveries d SET artifact_delivery = CAST(#{receipt,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), lease_until = now() + interval '30 seconds', updated_at = now() WHERE AND d.input_event_id = #{inputID} AND d.lease_owner = #{owner} AND d.state = 'sent' AND d.lease_until > now() RETURNING input_event_id ) SELECT input_event_id FROM changed
SELECT FROM channel_reply_deliveries d WHERE AND d.state IN ('sent', 'sending') AND d.lease_until < now() ORDER BY d.created_at LIMIT 100
